notes.title: Prominence Group Play on Senscape Discord + Giveaways
notes.notes:
Our friends over at Senscape (who we worked with on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/272060/Serena/]Serena[/url]) have a wonderful Discord community of adventure gamers. They regularly host group plays where they put aside any walkthroughs and instead depend on fellow members while playing a chosen adventure game.

Beginning this Friday, December 14, the group will be playing Prominence and you're all officially invited! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10558099/cb6a4a7a1f182d5535cad4ab41c6581a73f42eb5.png[/img]

As they say in their guidelines: 
[quote]Start your game in your own time zone and play at your own pace.  Some people work, have families, some do not. Some will finish in a few days, some in a week or more; it’s not a race. If you have questions on what to do, where to go or how the game works, feel free to ask them on the game page. 
Group plays are also about keeping one another motivated and encouraged; holding hands is needed at times or a good old "slap-up-side-the-head" if you become hysterical. We LOVE to chat it up and see how each other are doing. It does not matter if you have played every Group game or this is your first. Do not be shy. We want to know you!
[/quote]

In addition, they'll be doing some game giveaways tonight and tomorrow, so if you head over there now, you can get in the running for a new game. 

Here's the link:
http://discord.gg/senscape 

Look for the delightfully named "Group Therapy" section.

There will also be a developer Q&A channel where we'll be dropping by to answer questions about the story, puzzles, characters, game world, and more.  :)

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: New Art & Design Developer Chat + Biggest Discount Ever!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to share the latest installment of our Prominence Developer Chat series, and this time it's all about the art!

Join concept artist & designer Gary Ritchie and Digital Media Workshop's Mike Morrison for details and a few laughs about the process of developing in-game designs and technologies, their connection to colonization plans for Mars, and the challenges of working collaboratively on art designs while living hundreds of miles apart.

Watch it in the embedded video below, or [url=https://youtu.be/Yas6J2d0I4U]via this link[/url] if you'd rather watch it in your browser.

https://youtu.be/Yas6J2d0I4U

If you enjoy this video, you can also check out the previous episodes in the series, including the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-N0_WfDiM6g]Audio Developer Chat[/url] and the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dALp6AxOEQ]Story Developer Chat[/url].

Finally, we wanted to let you know that [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270230]Prominence is at its lowest price ever during this Steam Winter Sale: 55% off -- just $8.99 USD[/url][/b]. Hurry, though! This price is only available until the end of the sale.

Cheers and happy holidays!!

notes.title: Coming Soon: Lower Regional Prices & New Currencies!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10558099/21d880a1e86b3a06e39556f574eb8663d6d43613.gif[/img]

As a tiny development studio we can't be keen on market economics for all regions around the world.

Luckily, Valve advises us on pricing, and their latest analysis includes some recommendations for regions outside places where the US dollar and Euro are the primary currency.

We've decided to take Valve's advice and change the purchase price of Prominence, but [u]only in cases where the new recommended price is lower[/u]. That means there will be [b]no regional pricing increases, only decreases[/b].


[h1]Price Reductions[/h1]
In the next few weeks (we've already submitted the changes to Valve), pricing for Prominence on Steam will be adjusted downward for regions that use the following currencies:
[list]
[*]Indonesian Rupiah
[*]Philippine Peso
[*]Singapore Dollar
[*]Thai Baht
[*]Korean Won
[*]Indian Rupee
[*]Chilean Peso
[*]Peruvian Sol
[*]Colombian Peso
[*]South African Rand
[*]Hong Kong Dollar
[*]Taiwanese Dollar
[*]Saudi Arabian Riyal
[*]Emirati Dirham
[/list]
If you're in one of those areas and Prominence is on your wishlist, keep an eye out for the new pricing.


[h1]New Currencies[/h1]
In addition to those pricing reductions, several new regional currencies will soon become available here on Steam. We've submitted new prices for Prominence based on the latest market analysis for these areas:
[list]
[*]Vietnamese Dong
[*]Ukrainian Hryvnia
[*]Australian Dollar
[*]Polish Zloty
[*]Argentine Peso
[*]Israeli New Shekel
[*]Kazakhstani Tenge
[*]Kuwaiti Dinar
[*]Qatari Rial
[*]Costa Rican Colon
[*]Uruguayan Peso
[/list]

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Prominence Prologue e-book now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that we've released a free compilation of the Prominence Prologue for Kindle and other e-book readers, along with a desktop-friendly PDF version. :belos:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10558099/e6144bc921e8179233f4f4787c4f10a7931a922e.jpg[/img]

Included in this collection are:
- Newly edited versions of all 10 of the original Prominence Prologue story vignettes
- A previously unreleased bonus chapter, "Reitessa's Concern"
- A brief forward from the dev team
- Linked table of contents for quick access to each chapter

If you're interested in Prominence, but haven't yet purchased it, these short scenes of backstory will help set the stage for the events in the game.

You can view :lefteyecon::righteyecon: and download all three versions of the e-book -- MOBI, EPUB, and PDF -- [url=https://www.dropbox.com/sh/oz944igw5i8ojl8/AAAWvpvr3KDSdwWHtFZEXNrya?dl=0]right here[/url].

Happy adventuring and thanks for your support!

notes.title: Guided Walkthrough Now Available
notes.notes:
If you've been stumped by a particularly tricky puzzle, or would prefer to play Prominence as a more guided narrative experience, get ready for awesomeness because today we're releasing the official Prominence Guided Walkthrough!

Rather than just a bullet-point to-do list, we've put together a comprehensive 34-page guide to take you on the epic sci-fi adventure from beginning to end(ings), including solutions for all the puzzles plus cues along the way where you can find extra story content.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10558099/65ae2e924db0088c5b5776a5c47d3bf4c471bb54.png[/img]

The letter-sized layout and PDF format make it a tablet-friendly companion. Or, go old school and print it out. We left plenty of margin space for notes! (And if you don't have either of those options, it will work just fine in your favorite PDF reader while ALT-TABing in and out of the game.)

Here on Steam, the walkthrough can be found in the Prominence game directory:
..\Steam\steamapps\common\Prominence\Prominence_Guided_Walkthrough.pdf

The Prominence Guided Walkthrough is the latest in our ongoing series of free Prominence extras for everyone who owns the game. We've also released the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/270230/announcements/detail/845913277506017235]complete original soundtrack[/url] and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/270230/announcements/detail/988906472304570573]voice-actor outtakes reel[/url]. More goodies will continue to release in the coming weeks!

notes.notes:
As part of our continuing series of extra goodies, we are releasing the Prominence voiceover outtake reel.  Everyone who owns the game here on Steam will receive a copy, which provides some funny moments from the voiceover sessions. notes.title: Prominence Soundtrack Release, New Dev Chat Now Online, and Coming Soon: Integrated Graphics Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're excited to announce that the first in our series of extra Prominence goodies is releasing today. Everyone who owns the game here on Steam will receive a digital version of the Official Soundtrack for Prominence. Once the new update downloads to your system, check inside your Prominence game directory under Steam. You'll find a new "soundtrack" directory with 14 tracks of music from the game, plus 2 bonus tracks from our audio sessions.

To accompany the release of the soundtrack, we're also releasing our newest Developer Chat. Spend an extended coffee break with Mike and Tom and you'll hear all kinds of fun details about the soundtrack development, the origins of Old Letarri for the choir, the voice-actor casting/auditions, the foley sessions, and more.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-N0_WfDiM6g

We're also pleased to report that integrated chipsets will soon have even more compatibility with Prominence. Our prototype build with a new hotspot placement system has entered beta and is being tested.

If you've had trouble with seemingly broken hotspots in Prominence -- particularly on Windows 10 and Intel HD Graphics chipsets -- please feel free to contact us ( support@digitalmediaworkshop.net ) if you'd like to help with testing.

Thank you for supporting Prominence and for supporting indie adventure games. Stay tuned for more upcoming goodies as we venture through the holiday season!

notes.title: Prominence: atmospheric first-person sci-fi adventure out November 6
notes.notes:
One of the best things in games is discovering a new one that seems right up your street, and that's out in just a few days' time. That's just happened to me with Prominence, a first-person (i.e. a bit like Myst or Dark Fall) point and click sci-fi adventure. It's a game where you'll click, rather than walk your way through its gleaming white, Arthur C. Clarke-esque world, but it seems much less static than you might be expecting from this sort of thing. Here's a wonderfully informative trailer, so you can see what I mean:

Looks promising, doesn't it? Prominence-ing, I could say, if I was awful, but I'm not, so I won't. I particularly like the promise of puzzles that support the story, rather than puzzles that simply delay it and get in the way, like in many adventure games. Anyway, here's the premise, from the Steam page:

"After living for generations as persecuted refugees, the Letarri people set their sights on a far-off planet as a promising new home. But when the interstellar mission to colonize the new world goes terribly awry, the fate of their people falls into the hands of a lone adventurer. Now it's up to you to unravel the mystery of what happened. Can you save them and their mission, or is it already too late?"

Prominence is out November 6, and I think it looks really prominence-ing. Sorry. (Thanks, IndieGames!)

notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who supported us during development and during Greenlight! To show our appreciation, we've put together a pretty cool pre-order option for you. 

For a limited time, pre-orders are now available with a [b]20% discount[/b] at http://www.prominencegame.com

Not only is this package discounted, it includes a Steam key + a DRM-free Windows version, plus an exclusive option to get your name into the finished game as a founding settler of New Letarr with a colonist profession of your choice!

Hurry! This offer is only available until the game unlocks on November 6.
